item.title: ZPHQ Jammu observes National Voters’ Day with pledge ceremony
item.description: JAMMU: Zonal Police Headquarters (ZPHQ) Jammu on Friday observed National Voters’ Day (NVD) by administering the NVD Pledge to officers and staff, under the directions of IGP Jammu. item.description: RAMBAN: Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Gool, Imtiaz Ahmed conducted a surprise visit to Gool Market and Community Health Centre (CHC) Gool to review the prevailing situation and assess winter preparedness, particularly snow clearance, road connectivity and power supply in the area. item.title: J&K LG Grants Cabinet Rank to CM Advisor Nasir Aslam Wani
item.description: JAMMU: Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha on Saturday accorded Nasir Aslam Wani, Advisor to the Chief Minister, the rank and privileges of a Cabinet Minister. item.title: Jammu’s Tawi River Front Illuminated with Tricolour Façade Lighting
item.description: JAMMU: Ahead of Republic Day celebrations, the Tawi River Front was illuminated with tricolour façade lighting on Saturday evening, presenting a vibrant display of patriotic spirit in Jammu. item.title: Jammu-Srinagar Highway Closed for Third Day Amid Fresh Snowfall
item.description: SRINAGAR: The Jammu-Srinagar national highway remained closed for the third consecutive day on Sunday as fresh snowfall affected several parts of Kashmir, including Srinagar, officials said. item.description: JAMMU: The Jammu–Srinagar National Highway (NH-44) was partially restored on Sunday, with authorities initiating efforts to clear stranded vehicles between the Navyug Tunnel and Nashri Tunnel, officials said.
